_template: OHMYJOB-TEMPLATE: replace the mock values with yours, then delete this line

search._sources: List of boards to search, in priority order (the first keeps a job listed twice). Default ["linkedin"]. Valid values: linkedin, indeed, zip_recruiter, glassdoor, google, bayt, naukri, bdjobs, hellowork, freehire.
search._search_query: List of job titles to search, one search per term and board. Default [] (nothing is searched).
search._location: Text: a city or region, for example "Berlin, Germany". Default "". Google needs a city here.
search._country: Text: the country for indeed and glassdoor (required while either is in sources). Default "". Valid values: argentina, australia, austria, bahrain, belgium, brazil, canada, chile, china, colombia, costa rica, czech republic, denmark, ecuador, egypt, finland, france, germany, greece, hong kong, hungary, india, indonesia, ireland, israel, italy, japan, kuwait, luxembourg, malaysia, mexico, morocco, netherlands, new zealand, nigeria, norway, oman, pakistan, panama, peru, philippines, poland, portugal, qatar, romania, saudi arabia, singapore, south africa, south korea, spain, sweden, switzerland, taiwan, thailand, türkiye, ukraine, united arab emirates, uk, usa, uruguay, venezuela, vietnam.
search._recency_days: Whole number: only postings from the last N days. Default 1. 0 = no age limit.
search._results_per_term: Whole number, 1 or more: results requested per term and board. Default 30.
search._employment_types: List of allowed employment types. Default ["fulltime", "parttime", "contract"]. [] = every type. Valid values: fulltime, parttime, contract, temporary, internship, perdiem, other, volunteer.
search._exclude_companies: List of company names to skip. Default [].
search._exclude_seniority_level: List of seniority words to skip (for example "director", "intern"). Default [].
search._filter_title_terms: List of words that drop a posting when they appear in its title. Default [].
search._title_filter: Text: "strict" keeps a posting only if its title matches a search term (accents and word forms ignored), "off" keeps every title. Default "strict". Valid values: strict, off.
search._title_aliases: Object {"word": "replacement"}: extra words that count as a match, applied to the search term and the title, for example {"ops": "operations"}. Default {}.
search._title_only_aliases: Object {"word": "replacement"}: aliases applied to the posting title only, for example {"manager": "coordinator"}. Default {}.
search._languages: List of language codes of the postings, for word-form matching. Default ["en"]. Valid values: ar, ast, bg, ca, cs, cy, da, de, el, en, enm, eo, es, et, fa, fi, fr, ga, gd, gl, grc, gv, hbs, he, hi, hu, hy, id, is, it, ka, la, lb, lt, lv, mk, ml, ms, nb, nl, nn, pl, pt, ro, ru, se, sk, sl, sq, sv, sw, tl, tr, uk.
search._uk_sponsor_only: true or false: with the freehire source only, keep only jobs from UK sponsor-licensed employers; other boards ignore it. Default false.
search._git_snapshot: true or false: commit the tracker and Applications/ before a scrape (skipped outside a git repository). Default false.

pipeline._max_parallel_workers: Whole number, 1 or more: workers running at once (capped below Claude Code's subagent limit by one). Default 5.
pipeline._resume_max_pages: Whole number: page limit for a tailored resume (a CV has none). Default 1. 0 = no limit.
pipeline._resume_paper: Text: the paper size of the PDFs. Default "a4". Valid values: a4, letter.
